name: Marcus T.
text: This is interesting but I've actually seen the opposite work better for luxury goods. When we tested $99 vs $97 on our premium skincare line, $99 converted higher. Maybe it depends on the market segment?

name: Elena R.
text: The charm pricing thing feels outdated honestly. Our customers barely notice the difference between $97 and $99 anymore. We've had better results focusing on value communication instead.
